I searched the whole repo for `issue.created` (skipping `node_modules` and `.next`). Some hits were only the `issue.createdAt` property, not the event name, so I left out three files: `src/app/api/export/issues/route.ts`, `src/components/domain/issue/issue-detail.tsx` and `tests/services/notification-service.test.ts`.

That leaves 14 files that contain the event name:

- **Where the event is defined and typed:**
  - `src/types/event.ts` (the event map key)
  - `src/types/activity.ts` (the activity action type)
  - `src/schemas/activity.ts` and `src/schemas/webhook.ts` (the allowed-value lists)
- **Where it is emitted:** `src/server/services/issue-service.ts`. This file also mentions the name in a doc comment.
- **Where it is subscribed to:** the activity, usage, search and webhook services under `src/server/services/`. The activity and webhook services also pass the string along as a value, so it gets recorded in activity entries and sent in webhook deliveries.
- **UI label:** `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`
- **Tests:** `tests/lib/event-bus.test.ts`, `tests/server/domain-events.test.ts`, `tests/services/issue-service.test.ts`, `tests/services/activity-service.test.ts` and `tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts`

Because the activity and webhook services write the name out as data, renaming it would also affect activity records already saved under the old name and any webhook consumers that match on it.

ANSWER: src/types/event.ts, src/types/activity.ts, src/schemas/activity.ts, src/schemas/webhook.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts, tests/server/domain-events.test.ts, tests/components/activity-grouping.test.ts, tests/lib/event-bus.test.ts, tests/services/issue-service.test.ts, tests/services/activity-service.test.ts
